title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, bump actions & deps, improve cache parallelism
author: Sophie Lin
description: Motivation: our repository has accumulated a number of overlapping GitHub Actions workflows and legacy caching patterns which increase CI runtime, cause cache misses, and make release automation brittle. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into a small set of predictable pipelines, bumps core Actions and Node toolchains, and applies repo hygiene to deprecated workflow fragments. Scope and changes (single continuous description): Consolidate separate lint and test workflow fragments into dedicated 'ci-lint.yml' and 'ci-test.yml' with a shared cache-utils workflow for restoring/saving dependency caches; split lint and test so lint runs fast on PRs and tests run with a tuned matrix for integration coverage; improve cache key determinism (node-version + platform + hash(package-lock.json|pnpm-lock.yaml) + job-marker) to reduce cross-job collisions; reduce matrix cardinality by moving OS permutations to targeted jobs and using a smaller matrix for unit tests; bump core GH Actions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) and adopt the newer node-setup job patterns; update release automation to use the consolidated 'release.yml' with improved dry-run and tag permissions checks; remove deprecated workflows under .github/workflows/legacy-*.yml and move helper scripts into scripts/ci; small package.json devDependency bumps (eslint, mocha) where required for Action compatibility; add cross-repo compatibility notes in docs/ci.md and update README CI section. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows (ci-lint, ci-test, release, cache-utils) - [x] Bump actions to v4 and update usage patterns - [x] Reduce matrix size and improve cache keys - [x] Migrate helper scripts into scripts/ci and document changes - [x] Run full CI and a release dry-run Linear tickets: ENG-2483 (CI unification), INF-102 (cache hygiene). Related support ticket: SUP-512. Rollout notes: This is a repository-level CI refactor with no runtime code changes. We will monitor CI runs for the next 48 hours and revert workflows if cache regressions or test flakiness increases. The release workflow includes a dry-run validation step before any tags are pushed. If failures are observed, rollback is automated by restoring the previous workflow files from the branch 'ci-rollback/previous'. Author notes: kept the description compact and added migration notes in docs/ci.md to help contributors update local workflows. See commits summary and changed files for details.
commits_summary: 1) chore(ci): add unified ci-lint.yml and ci-test.yml; 2) chore(ci): add cache-utils workflow and refactor restore/save scripts; 3) chore(ci): bump actions/checkout/setup-node/cache to v4 and update job patterns; 4) chore(deps): bump eslint/mocha devDeps for GH Actions compatibility; 5) docs: update docs/ci.md and README; 6) chore(ci): remove legacy workflows and add migration notes
